title.narrative: Harmoniser l’approche collective de redevabilité envers les populations affectées, à travers la mise en place d’un mécanisme inter-organisation de communication, de partage d’information et de gestion efficace des feedbacks communautaires.

description.narrative: The main objective of this UNHCR project is to establish a collective mechanism of accountability to affected populations by extending UNHCR's 'AAP call center' to the entire humanitarian system and strengthening community complaint management mechanisms, with a view to an inclusive response tailored to community concerns. The project provides the humanitarian community with a collective mechanism for managing community complaints, strengthening capacities of community structures and humanitarian actors, and organizations with the aim of programming, monitoring and evaluation of the humanitarian response. The intervention provides humanitarian assistance to 1,205,010 people (229,597 men, 278,838 women and 696,575 children) including 5,824 persons with disabilities.
